EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 477 December 27, 1976
EXTENDING THE TERM OF THE PRESIDENTIAL COMMISSION ON REORGANIZATION
CREATED UNDER EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 281, SERIES OF 1970
WHEREAS, it has been declared policy to pursue a continuing program of administrative reform that would
assure and sustain the reinvigoration of the bureaucracy;
WHEREAS, full implementation of the Integrated Reorganization Plan (IRP), as amended, as enjoined to be
effected pursuant to Letter of Instructions No. 449, is about to be completed;
WHEREAS, there is now therefore need to evaluate, follow-up and monitor the extent and effectiveness of the
implementation of the IRP, as amended, particularly as this pertains to administrative decentralization and
regionalization, to ensure that implementation has been affected not only in form but also in substance;
WHEREAS, there is need to provide continued staff advice and assistance to the Office of the President in
assessing proposals for further organizational changes and adjustments emanating from the various
government agencies to assure consistency with the major thrusts and principles of the reorganization;
WHEREAS, there is a need for the Presidential Commission on Reorganization (PCR) to provide continued
technical and administrative support to a desired extended study of government corporations pursuant to
Executive Order No. 464; and
WHEREAS, it is desirable for the PCR to continue providing staff assistance and consultative advice to the
Civil Service Commission in the assessment of proposals for exemptions from the civil service pursuant to
P.D. No. 868, to the Career Executive Service Board in the administration of the career executive service, and
to the various agencies of the government with respect to reorganization matters.
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers
vested in me by the Constitution, do hereby extend the term of the Presidential Commission on
Reorganization up to December 31, 1977.
The Presidential Executive Assistant shall issue the necessary directives for the detail or the extension of the
detail of such technical personnel as may be needed by the Commission, under the same conditions as
prescribed in Executive Order No. 281, as amended.
The Commission is authorized to disburse and defray all expenses for its operations from January 1 to
December 31, 1977 from funds as may be available from the Office of the President.
Done in the City of Manila, this 27th day of December, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-six.
